rule: Do not send or initiate any external confirmation/contact for Historical5000 or related source access.
prohibited_contact_channels: follow-up asking whether prior contact was received
allowed_research_inputs: publicly available documents/pages accessed within their terms
existing artifacts already held by the project
already-connected tools and services used without contacting third parties
source_admission_implication: A source may pass only from public/existing evidence sufficient to prove permission/terms and temporal semantics. If that proof cannot be established without contacting the provider, remain BLOCKED_FAIL_CLOSED.
